newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade $62, light - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade $62, light - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 8 (Reuder) - Trade was slow, with a few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry was moderate and demand light. Confirmed - 900.

Sales confirmed on 400 slaughter steers and 500 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 52,700 head confirmed including 8,000 head or about 15 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - few Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lbs 62.00; pen Select with end Choice 1225 lbs 61.50. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 62.00, couple pens 980-1000 lbs 61.00.
